name: Knight of Xoroth: buying Flames of Xoroth rank 2 keeps one Warbringer row in the client spellbook (#12823)
contract: Warbringer 570727 (War specialization 18) transforms Flames of Xoroth: the server shows Flames rank 1 801059
to the client as Warbringer rank 1 802581 (SMSG_SUPERCEDED_SPELL), so the client spellbook holds 802581 and
not 801059. Warbringer rank 2 802582 is level 18, so a level-16 knight that buys Flames rank 2 802411
(trainer 900017, Spi'ro 50278, level 16, requires 801059) still sees Warbringer rank 1. #12823 reports a second
Warbringer row instead: the rank supersede told the client 801059 -> 802411, which the client does not hold,
so it appended 802411, and the replacement 802411 -> 802581 then appended a second 802581. After the
purchase the client must hold exactly one 802581 row and neither Flames rank.
